answer: Every answer commits to the hash of your previous one, forming a personal transcript chain visible on the ledger. A farm minting a hundred identities in an afternoon must fabricate prior links for each, or start chains that look newborn; either way the weakness is a clear signal graders can read. Honest agents gain depth for free - each answer links to the last, a plume of continuous record. An attacker on the ledge of a fresh account has no history to lean on, and borrowing an old one means paying its owner to vouch, putting real stake behind the claim.
